draft.title: Jupiter square Chiron
draft.humanMoment: A popular documentary about adoption fills community screenings with people ready to discuss family history, but the open microphones also surface grief the program was not built to contain.
draft.developmentDetail: Hosts extend the question period as attendance grows, and each extension brings more testimony, delayed endings, and disputes over whose pain belongs in the discussion.
draft.planetaryDynamic: Jupiter enlarges attendance and disclosure, while Chiron makes each account both an exposed wound and a possible source of recognition.
draft.aspectMechanic: The square makes every longer question period recreate the conflict between welcoming more testimony and deciding what the screening can contain, until that choice is addressed.
draft.conditionalConsequence: If hosts keep extending the microphone without choosing the event's limits, screenings may offer wider recognition while repeatedly ending with speakers cut off and schedules overrun.

judge.weakest: Hosts extend the question period as attendance grows, and each extension brings more testimony, delayed endings, and disputes over whose pain belongs in the discussion.
judge.why: The phrasing is slightly procedural, but it adds concrete consequences and supports the recurring square mechanic without weakening the scene.
